description: City-by-city neuro evaluation frameworks, therapy next-step guides, and official lookup links. No rankings. No endorsements.
main_html:
Quick answer:

Before contacting any provider, make sure you know whether you need testing, therapy, or both — and what questions you want answered in writing.

What to do next: Use the guide hub when you still need a decision path, the FAQ when you need a quick clarification, and the market page only after you know what you need to verify locally.

Common mistake: jumping straight to provider research before cost, fit, red-flag, and verification questions are clear.
